formula: original same-hour quantiles v2; distinct from live previous-hour v3

metric_definitions.frequency: complete UTC calendar days; net of all fees and funding
metric_definitions.sortino: sqrt(365) * mean(r) / sqrt(mean(min(r, 0)^2)); denominator includes ALL days
metric_definitions.sharpe: sqrt(365) * mean(r) / sample_std(r, ddof=1); risk-free return assumed zero
metric_definitions.undefined_ratio: null when the denominator is zero

provenance: Original baseline replay; baseline hourly accounting parity verified locally.
scope: Historical simulation using revised data, not live account returns.
